# Greek Empire

Greek empire may refer to the following Greek regimes:
Classical Greece
* Macedonia (ancient kingdom)
Hellenistic world
In the Hellenistic period, "Greek empire" may refer to any of the successor states of the Macedonian empire, including:
* Ptolemaic Egypt under Ptolemaic dynasty
* Seleucid Empire under Seleucid dynasty
Middle Ages
In the Middle Ages, Greek empire can refer to:
* Byzantine Empire
